What You Will Experience

Key Sightseeing Attractions

Carefully curated by local Rajasthan travel experts for the best photography and experience.

01

The Great Wall of India

36-kilometer stone wall, the 2nd longest continuous wall in the world after the Great Wall of China

02

Badal Mahal (Palace of Clouds)

Highest point of the fort with 360-degree views of Thar desert border

03

Birthplace of Maharana Pratap

Iconic heroic birthplace steeped in Mewar pride

04

Over 360 Ancient Temples

Ancient Hindu and Jain shrines within the citadel walls

05

Evening Light & Sound Show

Spectacular illumination of fort ramparts (optional for afternoon bookings)
